title: SieveScript/set args
description: Arguments for SieveScript/set (RFC 9661). Creates, updates, or destroys SieveScript objects, and optionally changes the active script when every operation succeeds.

accountId.description: The account to apply changes to.

ifInState.description: Optimistic concurrency guard. Fails with stateMismatch if the SieveScript state differs.

create.description: Map of client-assigned creation ids to SieveScript create objects. name is optional and nullable (defaults to the script id); blobId is required and is an upload id or an sv: id of this account.

update.description: Map of SieveScript id to PatchObject. Only explicitly listed properties are changed; server-set properties may be included only with their current value.

onSuccessActivateScript.description: Id of the script to activate if every create, update and destroy succeeded. Creation references (#id) are allowed. An invalid or unknown id is ignored.

onSuccessDeactivateScript.description: If true and every create, update and destroy succeeded, deactivate the active script. Processed before onSuccessActivateScript.
